issues.message: Reduce the total number of break and continue statements in this loop to use at most one.
issues.reason: The continues are guard clauses that skip non-matching sessions. Collapsing them into one exit would mean nesting the body in conditionals — strictly harder to read.

issues.message: Reduce the total number of break and continue statements in this loop to use at most one.

issues.reason: restore() maps a persisted game row onto a session; the parameters are the columns. A cap of 7 is the same arbitrary threshold as method length, which this project suppresses.

issues.message: Avoid non-native interactive elements. If using native HTML is not possible, add an appropriate role and support for tabbing, mouse, keyboard, and touch inputs to an interactive content element.
issues.reason: A board square is a drag/drop surface, not a control. Making the board keyboard-playable means arrow-key square navigation with a focus cursor — a real feature to design, not a role attribute to bolt on. Tracked separately if we take it on.

issues.message: Avoid non-native interactive elements. If using native HTML is not possible, add an appropriate role and support for tabbing, mouse, keyboard, and touch inputs to an interactive content element.
issues.reason: Inner div's onClick only calls stopPropagation to keep backdrop clicks from closing the dialog; it is not an interactive control, so a keyboard handler is meaningless here.

issues.message: Visible, non-interactive elements with click handlers must have at least one keyboard listener.
issues.reason: The inner div's onClick only calls stopPropagation, so a backdrop click does not close the dialog through it. Not an interactive control; a keyboard handler would be meaningless.

issues.message: Use the "java.time" API for date and time.
issues.reason: JwtUtil already models time with java.time (Instant, Duration). Date.from() appears only at the JJWT API boundary, whose issuedAt/expiration signatures take java.util.Date — there is no java.time overload to switch to.

issues.message: Do not use Array index in keys
issues.reason: Captured pieces are append-only and never reordered or removed, and the list holds duplicates (two rooks, eight pawns) so no value-based key exists. Index keys are correct for this list.
